contradicting_evidence: Negative settled BTC and ETH ETF flows, together with stablecoin contraction across all supplied windows, provide a directional argument for renewed downside rather than complete neutrality.
Positive BTC and ETH returns, widespread advances and mid-/small-proxy relative strength provide an opposing argument for rebound continuation.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The weekly endpoint is unresolved. The rebound could develop into sustained repair or fail against the adverse slower liquidity backdrop, but the supplied evidence does not establish a dominant path. Stabilization, recovery and broad rotation remain separate tests rather than an assumed progression.
falsification_conditions: A sustained sequence of resilient BTC and ETH prices, stronger ETH/BTC, persistent beta-asset breadth and improving settled flows would replace NO_EDGE with an upward directional case.
Persistent failure of the repair, weakening ETH/BTC and narrowing participation alongside continued adverse flows would replace NO_EDGE with a downward directional case.
missing_evidence: A multi-session sequence connecting price resilience, relative strength, breadth and settled flows.
Evidence that stablecoin supply contraction has reversed or that available liquidity is being deployed into crypto risk assets.
Canonical broad-alt confirmation, full small-cap coverage and any microcap observations.
Current macro developments or verified catalysts capable of changing the weekly balance.
supporting_evidence: The current positive price-and-breadth snapshot conflicts with negative settled ETF flows and contracting stablecoin supply; neither side has supplied persistence sufficient to establish a weekly endpoint edge.
Thirty-day alt participation remains weak relative to BTC, while the supplied 90-day measures are mixed rather than evidence of broad alt leadership.

The observed transmission is uneven: mid- and small-proxy participation is stronger, but only one-third of large-alt proxy constituents outperform BTC. This does not establish a durable market-wide rotation.
